ex.s: We found a great package tour for the end of March.
ex.t: 我们为三月底找到了一个很棒的跟团游。

defs.def: a box, bag, etc. in which things are wrapped or packed; the contents of a box etc. 包；盒；袋；包装好的东西

ex.s: This is the Tiny Forest movement, which aims to prove that the best things in life really do come in small packages.
ex.t: 这就是微型森林运动，旨在证明生活中最好的东西确实来自小包装。

ex.s: Su Bo, a 26-year-old computer programmer in Shenzhen, says that he has given up eating packaged meals except when he’s travelling for work.
ex.t: 深圳26岁的计算机程序员苏波说，除了出差时，他已经放弃吃包装食品了。

ex.s: Both admit that in times of stress or busy periods at work, they do sometimes give in and eat fast food or packaged meals.
ex.t: 两人都承认，在压力大或工作繁忙的时候，他们有时确实会妥协，吃快餐或包装食品。

ex.s: You could also make healthy food at home and try to avoid eating packaged foods or fast food.
ex.t: 你也可以在家做健康食品，尽量避免吃包装食品或快餐。

ex.s: For more brochures about other package tours around Peru, please contact us on our official website.
ex.t: 如需更多关于秘鲁其他包价游的宣传册，请通过我们的官网联系我们。

defs.def: a set of items or ideas that must be bought or accepted together （必须整体接收的）一套东西，一套建议；一揽子交易

ex.s: Barcelona has put together a package of clean energy technologies to help public transportation go greener, while also doing its part to tackle climate change and aid Europe’s difficult shift to the privately owned electric vehicle market.
ex.t: 巴塞罗那已经汇集了一整套清洁能源技术，以帮助公共交通走向绿色，同时也在应对气候变化并帮助欧洲艰难地转向私人拥有的电动车辆市场方面尽了自己的职责。

defs.def: a set of related programs for a particular type of task, sold and used as a single unit 软件包
to put sth into a box, bag, etc. to be sold or transported 将 … 包装好
